rules: Each lane appends ONLY to its own file: ledger/presenter.jsonl or ledger/film.jsonl (one JSON object per line). Never edit SPEND-LEDGER.json.

Before every paid call append {"at","lane","item","provider","model","est_credits","est_usd","reason","status":"intent"}; after it append the same item with "status":"done" or "failed" and actual_credits/actual_usd (Higgsfield: balance before/after).
Sum your lane file (intent entries without a matching done/failed count at estimate) before each call; never exceed the lane allocation in this file. Stop and report instead.
No retry of an identical seeded request. A regeneration is a new intent entry with its own reason.

presenter-regen.includes: look-candidate stills and all regenerated presenter takes and restorations

amendments.note: Account balance 1,910 credits at authorization; the balance is also a hard limit.
